title: Equations of motion (গতির সমীকরণ)
placement: Book pages 45–46, topic 2.7: গতির সমীকরণ (Equations of Motion). Next to the section text and its velocity–time graph with V = (u+v)/2.
description: The equations of motion (গতির সমীকরণ, pages 45–46, 2.7) with a commuter train on a straight double-track railway in a sunny setting. The student sets its আদি বেগ u (m/s), ত্বরণ a (ms⁻², negative to brake: a braking train stops, it never goes backwards) and the time t with three steppers, and runs it in real time with one big button (its numbered ring on the train). The camera follows the train on a 40 m stretch of track; a trip bar fills in 1-second segments and the বেগ–সময় গ্রাফ draws v = u + at while the area under it fills in the same 1-second strips: the area is the distance. One equation at a time: chips choose v = u + at, s = ut + ½at², v² = u² + 2as or s = Vt; it shows large with the student's numbers, under a plain comparison first (e.g. twice the time, ut twice but ½at² four times). Each quantity has one colour (u teal, v orange, a green, t purple, s blue, V raspberry) in the graph, the steppers, the formulas and the labels; tapping a letter lights that quantity in the graph and in a tag over the train. With s = ut + ½at² the area splits into the rectangle ut and the gold triangle ½at²; with s = Vt an imagined see-through train runs at the average velocity V = (u + v)/2 and the triangle above V folds into the gap below it (s = Vt). A button সমীকরণ কীভাবে এল opens a derivation sheet: four steps from the graph (the slope: v = u + at; the area: s = ut + ½at²; the fold: s = Vt; t taken out: v² = u² + 2as), each with a small graph with the part in use lit, one plain sentence, then the formula line by line (পরের ধাপ / আগের ধাপ) with the student's own numbers, so the same answer comes out each way. A button উদাহরণ opens the book's worked example (page 45): a car from rest reaches 60 km/hour in 1 minute, what is its acceleration? A bright red car drives off from a start line on a plain avenue (street lamps only) with a speedometer in km/hour and m/s and a clock; it plays in real time or 2× or 5× faster, a finger turns the camera round the moving car, পাশ থেকে / পেছন থেকে put it beside or behind the car, and a timeline shows any moment; below, the question with two steppers (final speed 10–120 km/hour, time 10–120 s) and the book's answer line by line: t = 1 মিনিট = 60 s, v = 60 km/hour = (60 × 1000 m)/(60 × 60 s) = 16.67 m/s, v = u + at = at, a = v/t = 0.278 m/s². Touching or dragging the graph or the bar shows any moment (to 0.1 s). Test: 5 tap questions (the final velocity or the distance by formula, the distance as the area under the graph, the average velocity or the velocity at half time read off the graph, the next second's distance after the first, and no acceleration or braking to a stop), wrong choices from real mistakes, each worked answer naming the mistake and replaying the run. Phone-first, Bangla. GLB: a short stretch of the railway (−25 to 60 m) and the two trains, in metres.
